mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transaction_record (type, amount, category, description, transaction_date, asset_id, liability_id, account_change_type, create_by, update_by) VALUES (#{type}, #{amount}, #{category}, #{description}, #{transactionDate}, #{assetId}, #{liabilityId}, #{accountChangeType}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE transaction_record SET type = #{type}, amount = #{amount}, category = #{category}, description = #{description}, transaction_date = #{transactionDate}, asset_id = #{assetId}, liability_id = #{liabilityId}, account_change_type = #{accountChangeType}, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM transaction_record ORDER BY transaction_date DESC
